name: All Entries Summary
query:
SELECT 
  si.posting_date, 
  si.name, 
  'Sales Invoice' AS type, 
  si.customer AS party, 
  si.grand_total AS amount
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(doc_type)s = 'All' OR %(doc_type)s = 'Sales Invoice')
  AND (
    %(cost_center)s IS NULL OR %(cost_center)s = '' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii 
      WHERE sii.parent = si.name AND sii.cost_center = %(cost_center)s
    )
  )

UNION ALL

-- Purchase Invoice
SELECT 
  pi.posting_date, 
  pi.name, 
  'Purchase Invoice' AS type, 
  pi.supplier AS party, 
  pi.grand_total AS amount
FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
WHERE pi.docstatus = 1
  AND pi.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(doc_type)s = 'All' OR %(doc_type)s = 'Purchase Invoice')
  AND (
    %(cost_center)s IS NULL OR %(cost_center)s = '' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii 
      WHERE pii.parent = pi.name AND pii.cost_center = %(cost_center)s
    )
  )

UNION ALL

-- Journal Entry
SELECT 
  je.posting_date, 
  je.name, 
  'Journal Entry' AS type, 
  '' AS party, 
  je.total_debit AS amount
FROM `tabJournal Entry` je
WHERE je.docstatus = 1
  AND je.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(doc_type)s = 'All' OR %(doc_type)s = 'Journal Entry')
  AND (
    %(cost_center)s IS NULL OR %(cost_center)s = '' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea 
      WHERE jea.parent = je.name AND jea.cost_center = %(cost_center)s
    )
  )

UNION ALL

-- Payment Entry (لا توجد تصفية على cost_center)
SELECT 
  pe.posting_date, 
  pe.name, 
  'Payment Entry' AS type, 
  pe.party, 
  pe.paid_amount AS amount
FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
WHERE pe.docstatus = 1
  AND pe.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(doc_type)s = 'All' OR %(doc_type)s = 'Payment Entry')

UNION ALL

-- Purchase Order
SELECT 
  po.transaction_date AS posting_date, 
  po.name, 
  'Purchase Order' AS type, 
  po.supplier AS party, 
  po.base_grand_total AS amount
FROM `tabPurchase Order` po
WHERE po.docstatus = 1
  AND po.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(doc_type)s = 'All' OR %(doc_type)s = 'Purchase Order')

UNION ALL

-- Stock Entry
SELECT 
  se.posting_date, 
  se.name, 
  'Stock Entry' AS type, 
  se.purpose AS party, 
  se.total_outgoing_value - se.total_incoming_value AS amount
FROM `tabStock Entry` se
WHERE se.docstatus = 1
  AND se.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(doc_type)s = 'All' OR %(doc_type)s = 'Stock Entry')

ORDER BY posting_date DESC
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):
	if not filters:
		filters = {}

	from_date = filters.get("from_date")
	to_date = filters.get("to_date")

	columns = [
		{"label": "Creation Date", "fieldname": "creation", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 150},
		{"label": "Doctype", "fieldname": "doctype", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
		{"label": "Document Name", "fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Dynamic Link", "options": "doctype", "width": 200},
		{"label": "Created By", "fieldname": "owner", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
		{"label": "Status", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
	]

	data = frappe.db.sql("""
		SELECT 
			creation, 
			dt AS doctype, 
			name,
			owner,
			CASE 
				WHEN docstatus = 0 THEN 'Draft'
				WHEN docstatus = 1 THEN 'Submitted'
				WHEN docstatus = 2 THEN 'Cancelled'
				ELSE 'Unknown'
			END AS status
		FROM `tabVersion`
		WHERE 
			creation BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
		GROUP BY dt, name
		ORDER BY creation DESC
	""", {
		"from_date": from_date,
		"to_date": to_date
	}, as_dict=1)

	return columns, data
